## Overview

Local stress check for **two-part hurdle discrete LMTP**
([#35](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/issues/35)): binomial
**presence** (co-primary) and Gaussian **intensity | positive** under static
arm assignment. Uses a synthetic ecology-style panel (three arms, baseline
weight, repeated units).

This path complements:

- **`family_outcome=:binomial`** on single-outcome discrete LMTP ([#34](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/issues/34))
- **Hurdle CI testing** for DAG faithfulness ([#37](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/issues/37))
- **Repeated Gaussian MMRM** for visit trajectories ([#25](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl/issues/25))
- **Repeated-outcome MSM** for unstructured ``τ(t)`` under TMLE/IF

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-hurdle-stress-dgp
#| warning: false

using CausalTargeted
using DataFrames
using Distributions
using StableRNGs
using Statistics

const ARMS = ["R", "SS", "SC"]

function synthetic_hurdle_panel(;
    n_units::Int = 120,
    rng = StableRNG(20260830),
)
    rows = NamedTuple[]
    for unit in 1:n_units
        arm = rand(rng, ARMS)
        W = randn(rng)
        p_inf = arm == "SS" ? 0.62 : arm == "SC" ? 0.42 : 0.28
        infected = rand(rng, Bernoulli(p_inf))
        burden = infected ?
            exp(0.4 + 0.25 * W + (arm == "SS" ? 0.55 : arm == "SC" ? 0.15 : 0.0) + 0.3 * randn(rng)) :
            0.0
        push!(rows, (; mouse_id = unit, grid_type = arm, weight = W, fec = burden))
    end
    return DataFrame(rows)
end

function hurdle_columns!(df::DataFrame, raw::Symbol)
    df[!, Symbol(string(raw, "_bin"))] = Float64.(df[!, raw] .> 0)
    df[!, Symbol(string(raw, "_logpos"))] = [
        y > 0 ? log(y) : missing for y in df[!, raw]
    ]
    return df
end
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-hurdle-stress-estimate
#| warning: false

df = synthetic_hurdle_panel()
hurdle_columns!(df, :fec)
opts = recommend_run_options(nrow(df); engine = :lmtp, outcome = df.fec_bin)

res = run_two_part_discrete_lmtp_contrast(
    df, :grid_type;
    presence = :fec_bin,
    intensity = :fec_logpos,
    arm_hi = "SS",
    arm_ref = "R",
    levels = ARMS,
    baseline = [:weight],
    folds = opts.folds,
    learners_outcome = opts.learners_outcome,
    family_presence = opts.family_outcome,
    cluster = :mouse_id,
    rng = StableRNG(20260831),
)

@info "Presence contrast" res.presence.estimate res.presence.se
@info "Intensity | positive" res.intensity.estimate res.intensity.se res.intensity.n
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-hurdle-stress-summary
#| warning: false

summary_df = DataFrame(
    part = ["presence", "intensity"],
    estimate = [res.presence.estimate, res.intensity.estimate],
    se = [res.presence.se, res.intensity.se],
    n = [res.presence.n, res.intensity.n],
)
summary_df
```

## Pass criteria

- Both parts return finite estimates and SEs on the synthetic draw.
- Presence contrast is **positive** (SS arm shifts infection probability up).
- Intensity contrast is **positive** among observed positives.
- `recommend_run_options(...; outcome=fec_bin)` selects `family_outcome = :binomial`.
